decision_scope: Independent retained full-frame visual and file-identity review only. Root retains combined candidate acceptance; this is not H1, real-display/DPI, accessibility, physical, platform or release acceptance.

method.read: Complete AGENTS.md and docs/PLAN.md; current session README/CHECKPOINT/assignments; T3 contract, revision 2 and admissions; current implementation/capture/source-review notes and retained evidence.
method.visual: Direct tools.view_image calls on the original reference, every one of 15 current PNGs and every one of 13 genuine baseline PNGs. Images were opened individually or in bounded sequential before/after pairs, without edited or generated substitutes.
method.image_integrity: Read-only Python hashlib plus Pillow decoding of original retained files; no image was modified.
method.controls_hash_definition: SHA-256 of diagnostics.controls serialized with json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=True), UTF-8; derived comparison identity, not a saved-state format.

frames.name: play-reference-1672x941
frames.visual_observation: Stronger, brighter title strokes than the genuine before frame; open O/A counters, distinct serifs, restrained edge highlight and no broad halo. NOMINAL DRY ORGAN stays separate and legible; workspace tabs and all utility controls remain clear. Cyan upper drawbar focus is visible.

frames.name: play-default-1280x900
frames.visual_observation: Inactive compact layout retains its lighter title, small separate caption, full manuals/pedals and clear cyan upper drawbar focus. No new clipping or overlap; decoded full frame equals the before frame.

frames.name: play-minimum-960x700
frames.visual_observation: Inactive minimum compact layout retains the lighter title and readable separated caption. Drawbar and bank controls, compressed manuals and pedalboard remain within their panels; small labels remain a display-size limitation.

frames.name: service-reference-1672x941
frames.visual_observation: Inactive Service title and caption retain their appearance. Cyan Service-tab focus and six diagnostic panels remain visible; read-only nominal/not-connected disclosures are legible. Snapshot counter values differ between captures.

frames.name: service-minimum-960x700
frames.visual_observation: Inactive minimum Service layout retains the header and cyan Service-tab focus. Dense panel text wraps within cards with no observed new clipping; small diagnostic type remains a real-display readability consideration.

frames.name: rotary-reference-1672x941
frames.visual_observation: Inactive Rotary title and caption retain their appearance. Cyan Rotary-tab focus, cabinet art and read-only availability/not-connected disclosures remain visible. Snapshot counter values differ between captures.

frames.name: rotary-minimum-960x700
frames.visual_observation: Inactive minimum Rotary view retains a separated title/caption, visible cyan tab focus and legible primary disclosures. The cabinet illustration and wrapped explanatory text remain contained.

frames.name: flat-minimum-960x700
frames.visual_observation: Inactive minimum Flat view retains the lighter title, separate caption, simple flat controls and cyan upper drawbar focus. No new overlap or clipping observed.

frames.name: play-minimum-active-1400x820
frames.visual_observation: Revised title remains fully visible at the failed-v1 boundary size. Counters and interletter spaces stay open; weight is visibly stronger than before without a muddy rim. Caption stays distinct, and neither tabs nor small utility controls are touched.

frames.name: flat-reference-1672x941
frames.visual_observation: Inactive canonical Flat view retains its lighter title and separate caption. Simple cap/key shapes, cabinet disclosure, bank controls and cyan drawbar focus remain visually stable.

frames.name: play-toolbar-focus-1672x941
frames.visual_observation: Revised title matches the canonical treatment. Cyan outline around the selected PEDALS toolbar button remains distinct; pedal-octave text and footer focus caption remain visible, with no title/control collision.

frames.name: play-pedal-focus-1672x941
frames.visual_observation: Revised title and caption remain clear. Cyan outline around the rightmost pedal key remains contained and visible; the footer identifies Pedal 25 of 25. No visible focus loss or overlay.

frames.name: play-wide-1920x1080
frames.visual_observation: Revised title scales coherently, with open counters and visible restrained relief. It is prominent but does not overpower the illuminated Play control or manuals. Caption, tabs and tools remain separate.

frames.name: play-header-wide-1920x820
frames.visual_observation: Unequal wide/short layout keeps a compact undistorted title centered between the control groups, with clear subtitle separation. Relief does not become a stretched halo. Cabinet art is narrower within a wider panel; no same-size before PNG is present in the 13-frame baseline gallery.

frames.name: play-header-tall-1400x1080
frames.visual_observation: Unequal narrow/tall layout keeps title strokes and counters clear. The greater vertical subtitle gap follows the taller layout and remains readable; no overlap or clipping. A large dark gap under the cabinet art is a broader layout residual. No same-size before PNG is present in the 13-frame baseline gallery.

independent_canonical_image_statistics.predicate: 2126*R + 7152*G + 722*B >= threshold*10000; RGB decode; no hue predicate or resampling
independent_canonical_image_statistics.boundary: Image statistics corroborate visible weight; they do not establish physical luminance, exact font/material equality or whole-interface fidelity.

retained_numerical_evidence_read_not_rer.limits: This visual report does not replace independent source, numeric, material, input or platform gates.

residual_visual_differences: The reference title has more sculpted and spatially varied brass lighting; the five-pass live title remains a simpler, more uniform raster treatment.
The header is smoother and more evenly shaded than the textured, directionally lit reference panel. H1 remains separate.
Visible side wood and horizontal rims have different texture scale, blur and highlight profiles from the reference.
Key fronts, cap profiles, dark edges and inter-control shadows remain more regular and simplified than the reference.
Truthful live controls, bank/preset keys, pedalboard, utility tools, NOMINAL DRY ORGAN caption and unconnected-model labels differ from the concept control arrangement.
At 1400x1080 the cabinet panel has a large dark gap below its image; compact and Service labels are small at their native pixel sizes.
limitations: Two appended unequal-aspect current images have no same-size before PNG in the 13-frame baseline gallery; no paired visual equality is asserted for them.

Separate application runs carry live meter and snapshot-counter differences. Only play-default-1280x900 is byte/pixel identical as a whole to its gallery before frame. Gallery visual stability is not the deterministic inactive-pair equality gate.

PNG bytes and decoded pixels were independently verified. Original BMP removal follows the capture utility lossless-conversion receipts; this review did not recapture or independently reexecute the original conversion.
Software dummy-SDL captures do not establish real-display/DPI/input, accessibility or callback/device behavior.
